description: Type the 403 `module-upload-disabled` that putApp (PUT /v1/apps/{project}) gets for a module the team's builds did not produce. The spec documents it on that operation ("anything else is 403 `module-upload-disabled`") and on components.responses.Forbidden, which says this is the one 403 without a `reason`: the body is `{"error": "module-upload-disabled", "message": "..."}`, so the matcher reads `/error`. It generated as the generic Forbidden.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: `module.sha256` is neither the module the app runs nor one the team's builds produced. A team key cannot place other modules; ship new code with `createBuild`.
